cohort: 50 healthy singleton full-term infants (30 LGA and 20 AGA)
finding: Cord blood copeptin concentrations were similar in LGA and AGA infants after adjusting for delivery mode, but positively correlated with birth weight in the LGA group.
mod_finding: In the AGA group, cord blood copeptin concentrations were elevated in cases of vaginal delivery compared to elective cesarean section.
birth_weight: Birth weight was recorded and used to classify infants as LGA or AGA.
